+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Lightning Strike: This weapon stores the power of a volatile thunderstorm deep within. Occasionally, this dynamic power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with a massive lightning strike.
Shocking Blast 4: This weapon arcs with deadly electricity, dealing 4d6 Electric damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Electric damage on a critical hit.
Screeching 10: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 10d6 Sonic damage on each critical hit.
Thunderstorm Lore +16: Passive: Your Sonic and Lightning spells gain a +16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
